records.body: Trinidad and Tobago is home to the world’s largest natural reservoir of asphalt. Pitch Lake, located at La Breaon Trinidad's southwestern coast, covers 100 acres (40 hectares) and has a depth of about 250 ft (80 m), with the asphalt reserves estimated to weigh more than six million tons. European explorers used the asphalt to caulk their ships, and it was first used for road surfacing in 1815. Today, tens of thousands of tons of the asphalt are used annually for Trinidad and Tobago’s industries. The lake is a popular tourist attraction.
records.title: Pitch Lake
